finding.message: The webhook handler processes the request body without any validation or signature verification. This could allow unauthorized webhook deliveries.
finding.failure_scenario: An attacker can send an unsigned webhook payload to the new handler and have it processed as trusted input.
finding.why_now: This PR adds the webhook handler path, so request authentication needs to be enforced at the new entry point.
finding.suggested_fix:
let body = Request.body request in
match verify_signature ~ctx body with
| Ok () -> process_webhook ~ctx body
| Error _ -> Response.json `Unauthorized {|{"error": "invalid signature"}|}

results.evidence_notes: The finding is tied to the new webhook entry point and describes a concrete unsigned-request path.
